node.title: M720 complete bounded-band calibration certificates
node.statement: Complete calibration cells for h=7..20 have zero unpaid non-toral active cores. Any n=1024 window-slice result is explicitly labeled as slice-local and is not used as a global zero certificate.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the MITM gate, proved certificate semantics, and off-laptop complete zero certificates
node.falsifier: a complete calibration cell containing an unpaid non-toral active core, or a certificate that treats an incomplete window slice as a complete cell
